items.name: login-form
items.title: Login form
items.description: Logs a visitor in with an email and password, with a message for each failure and links to sign up and reset the password.
items.docs: Install @adirishi/offload-accounts at the version in this item's meta. The form calls logIn from @/server/account.functions, which you write. It links to /sign-up and /forgot-password. It uses the shadcn components button, checkbox, field, input, spinner, and textarea, which it doesn't install. Add the ones the site lacks with shadcn add, without --overwrite. See https://adirishi.github.io/offload-cms/customer-accounts

items.name: sign-up-form
items.title: Sign-up form
items.description: Creates an account with an email, a password, and a Turnstile check, then logs the visitor in or asks them to check their email.
items.docs: Install @adirishi/offload-accounts at the version in this item's meta. The form calls signUp from @/server/account.functions, which you write. It links to /login. It uses the shadcn components button, checkbox, field, input, spinner, and textarea, which it doesn't install. Add the ones the site lacks with shadcn add, without --overwrite. See https://adirishi.github.io/offload-cms/customer-accounts

items.name: change-password-form
items.title: Change password form
items.description: Changes the logged-in account's password after checking the current one, and ends its other sessions.
items.docs: Install @adirishi/offload-accounts at the version in this item's meta. The form calls changePassword from @/server/account.functions, which you write. Render it on a page behind the account guard. It uses the shadcn components button, checkbox, field, input, spinner, and textarea, which it doesn't install. Add the ones the site lacks with shadcn add, without --overwrite. See https://adirishi.github.io/offload-cms/customer-accounts

items.name: verify-email-form
items.title: Verify email form
items.description: Verifies the email of a verification link when the visitor presses a button, so mail scanners that open links verify nothing.
items.docs: Install @adirishi/offload-accounts at the version in this item's meta. The form calls verifyEmail from @/server/account.functions, which you write. Render it on the /verify-email page with the link's token. It links to /login. It uses the shadcn components button and spinner, which it doesn't install. Add the ones the site lacks with shadcn add, without --overwrite. See https://adirishi.github.io/offload-cms/customer-accounts

items.name: account-menu
items.title: Account menu
items.description: A header control with a log in link for visitors, and a menu with the account page and log out for a logged-in account.

It uses the shadcn components button and dropdown-menu, which it doesn't install. Add the ones the site lacks with shadcn add, without --overwrite. See https://adirishi.github.io/offload-cms/customer-accounts
